name: Autosheet
short_description_fr: Agent IA pour Excel et Google Sheets (ex-GPT for Work) : tu nettoies, enrichis et analyses tes lignes en masse, avec un essai gratuit puis des plans à partir de 23 €/mois.
features: AI agent for Excel and Google Sheets: clean, enrich, categorize, write formulas, format, and analyze; Bulk processing across hundreds of thousands of rows, plus GPT functions and a large choice of models; Autosheet MCP for Claude and ChatGPT (Google Sheets only); Free trial with no card; Standard and Business subscriptions after the trial

name: Treblo
short_description_fr: Générateur de chansons IA (ex-Sonauto) : morceaux illimités et gratuits sur le dernier modèle, avec un Pro optionnel à 9 €/mois pour la file prioritaire, les reprises et ta voix.
features: Unlimited free songs on the latest model, in thousands of styles, with optional instrumental tracks; Write your own lyrics or let Treblo write them, then edit, extend and iterate on sections; Downloads in OGG, MP3, WAV, FLAC and M4A, with no usage restrictions from Treblo on your songs; Optional Pro: priority queue, covers, style reuse, your voice, and stems (several features still in beta)

name: Async
short_description_fr: Éditeur vidéo IA (ex-Podcastle) : tu montes, sous-titres et génères des clips en parlant à Async, avec une offre gratuite puis des plans à partir de 19,99 €/mois.
features: Chat-based AI video editor: rough-cut cleanup, captions, clips, B-roll, music and audio cleanup; Remote multitrack recording, text-based audio editing, AI voices and optional voice cloning; Free plan with no card, plus Essentials, Pro and Teams credit plans and a custom Business offer; Formerly Podcastle; same product under a new name and domain

name: Anarlog
short_description_fr: Bloc-notes de réunion IA local et open source (ex-Hyprnote) : sans robot dans l’appel, données sur ton appareil, avec un Pro optionnel à 13 €/personne/mois.
features: Bot-free, local-first meeting notepad: notes, transcripts and recordings stay on your device by default; Open source, with on-device models or your own API keys, plus a local API, CLI, MCP and webhooks; Optional Pro: cloud transcription and LLM, system-wide dictation, sync, E2EE and team sharing; Desktop app for Mac, Windows (beta) and Linux (beta); built-in on-device transcription needs supported Apple Silicon

name: Arena
short_description_fr: Classement public des modèles d’IA (ex-LMArena) : tu confrontes deux modèles à l’aveugle et tu votes, gratuitement ; les évaluations entreprise se font sur devis.
features: Public AI ranking and leaderboards across text, image, video, code, search and more; Blind side-by-side battles: two anonymous models answer the same prompt, then you vote; The public leaderboard is officially kept free as a public service; Optional commercial AI Evaluations for labs and enterprises, with no published list price

name: Opera AI
short_description_fr: Assistant IA gratuit intégré au navigateur Opera (ex-Aria) : tu résumes tes pages, génères des images et analyses des fichiers, sans compte obligatoire.
features: Free, accountless AI assistant built into Opera, with models from OpenAI and Google; Page and tab-island context: summarize, compare, translate (about 50 languages) and extract key points without leaving the page; Image generation, file and image analysis, voice input and output; Optional free Opera Account for chat history and higher image limits; no paid Opera AI plan is published
